misprints.note: No accent is printed on ποδος.
The article is printed with υ instead of ο.
There is no full stop after ἡ.
An unusual form kept as printed. οδος is printed unaccented.

uncertain.note: The mark after πλέθρον looks like a full stop, though a comma would be expected. It may be a comma with a broken tail.
The final ς is broken and looks like a comma or semicolon.
The τ is broken in the print and looks like ι.
The accent sits between η and the diaeresis ι. It could be read as λήϊζεσθαι.

uncertain.text: λύπην ἔχειν ἔκ τινος: p. sig
uncertain.note: There is a space before the colon and no full stop is visible. It may be a broken ".:".
The stop after the second 3 is faint and has a small tail. It could be a comma.
